finalText:
Done - I've saved the Qatar Airways flight (QR8, London Heathrow to Kathmandu, departing 2 October at 08:25, £620 economy) to your trip.

One step left, and it's yours to take: open your itinerary page and hit "Confirm fare & pay". That re-checks the live fare first - airline prices move by the hour - and then takes you to secure payment. I can't take payment in chat, which is by design: you always see the final verified price before any money moves.

While you're there, want me to build out the rest of the Nepal itinerary around those dates?
